headline: [Video] "Who Knew Home Prices Would Rise Like This?" Angry 80-Year-Old in Gangnam [Real Estate 360]
summary: The government announced a tax reform plan on the 3rd that restructures real estate taxation around home value and actual residency. Home prices in Seoul's Apgujeong-dong and Banpo-dong districts are drawing attention.
why: Property taxation affects household wealth, housing demand and the financial exposure of banks that lend against homes in South Korea.
